brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Hex Cluster configurator checks fit/mesh only (check_build meshClash clear) and does not simulate or certify structural load; no load-rating property exists. Build provides multi-cell shelf structure with covers and bins (piece:0,0,1;full+cover:0,0,1;full;top with bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full etc.) but cannot be claimed as 50 kg rated.
Two half-base drawers fitted: drawer:0#-1,0#cut at -1,0,0 and drawer:0#1,1#cut at 1,1,0, plus bin:1,1,0~hex-bin-half-s-full tray

finish.summary: 2-level shelf assembly with 8 bases, 3 top covers and shelf bins plus 2 drawers. Mesh verified clear. 50 kg rating unmet – system cannot certify load ratings, only geometry.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
**Build:** 5 full hex cells forming a 2-level shelf tower (0,0,0 / 1,0,0 / 0,1,0 base level + 0,0,1 / 1,0,1 / 0,1,1 upper level) with top covers (`cover:0,0,1;full;top`, `cover:1,0,1;full;top`, `cover:0,1,1;full;top`) and bins as shelves. Two half-base drawers provide drawer storage.

Build verified: `check_build` meshClash **clear**, no errors (warnings LOOSE_BODY and OPEN_CAP_FACE are informational).

Load-rating is not a configurator-checked property (brief itself states “This checks fit, not strength: do not claim load ratings”). No 50 kg certification exists in Hex Cluster, so treated as unmet as enforced rule.

*Shelf bins and drawer trays installed: `bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full` (full-depth shelf tray in upper cell) and `bin:1,1,0~hex-bin-half-s-full` to demonstrate shelving/drawer combination. Additional bins can be added to any of the 108 offered bin sockets on the same cells.*
